elements.quote: Each device manufacturer or importer who initiates a correction or removal of a device that is not required to be reported to FDA under § 806.10 shall keep a record of such correction or removal.
elements.note: 806.1(a) also refers to maintaining records of all corrections and removals regardless of reportability.

pass2_change: Decision unchanged (CORRECTED), but the corrected citation now adds 806.1(b). Supplemental 806.1(b) confirmed it lists the exempt actions that 806.10(a)(2) routes to.
